SoundCloud is partnering with another generative AI music service, ElevenLabs.

SoundCloud is partnering with another generative AI music service, ElevenLabs.

by Terrence O'Brien

Nov 5, 2026, 3:00 PM UTC

Terrence O'Brien

is the Verge’s weekend editor. He’s covered the tech industry for over 18 years and knows a thing or two about synths.

After partnering with Moises earlier this year, SoundCloud is now adding integration with another AI music platform, ElevenLabs. Now, rather than having to export and download your outputs from ElevenLabs and then upload them to SoundCloud, you can publish them directly. As part of the partnership, SoundCloud Artist Pro subscribers are also getting three months of ElevenMusic Pro for free, so they can experiment with generative AI and potentially alienate their fans. Songs published from ElevenLabs directly to SoundCloud will be labeled as such, making clear their AI origins.

The integration between SoundCloud and ElevenLabs isn’t as deep as the Moises integration. That lets users pull tracks from SoundCloud into Moises for stem separation and remixing, then republish them directly to SoundCloud.

In general, SoundCloud has seemed more willing to embrace AI-generated music than other streaming services. While it “encourages” users subject to EU rules to label tracks as “AI-generated or manipulated” and has rules against impersonation, it’s also partnered with multiple generative AI music platforms. SoundCloud has also avoided the loud-and-proud press releases detailing how many spammy AI songs it’s removed from its platform, or bragging about demonetizing them.

跳至主要内容

SoundCloud 正与另一家生成式 AI 音乐服务商 ElevenLabs 合作。

SoundCloud 正与另一家生成式 AI 音乐服务商 ElevenLabs 合作。

作者 Terrence O'Brien

2026 年 11 月 5 日，UTC 时间下午 3:00

Terrence O'Brien

是 The Verge 的周末编辑。他报道科技行业已有 18 年多，对合成器也颇有了解。

继今年早些时候与 Moises 合作之后，SoundCloud 现在又加入了与另一家 AI 音乐平台 ElevenLabs 的集成。现在，你无需再从 ElevenLabs 导出并下载生成的作品，然后上传至 SoundCloud，而是可以直接发布。作为合作的一部分，SoundCloud Artist Pro 订阅用户还可免费获得三个月的 ElevenMusic Pro，以便尝试生成式 AI，并可能因此疏远自己的粉丝。从 ElevenLabs 直接发布到 SoundCloud 的歌曲将带有相应标签，明确表明其 AI 来源。

SoundCloud 与 ElevenLabs 的集成不如与 Moises 的集成深入。后者允许用户将 SoundCloud 上的音轨导入 Moises，进行分轨和混音，然后直接重新发布到 SoundCloud。

总体而言，SoundCloud 似乎比其他流媒体服务更愿意接纳 AI 生成的音乐。虽然它“鼓励”受欧盟规则约束的用户将音轨标记为“由 AI 生成或处理”，也制定了禁止冒充他人的规则，但它同时也与多个生成式 AI 音乐平台建立了合作。SoundCloud 也没有高调发布新闻稿，详细宣扬自己从平台上删除了多少垃圾 AI 歌曲，或吹嘘自己取消了这些歌曲的变现资格。
